$comment: THE FIXTURE POPULATION, AND WHAT RESTORING FIXTURE_PROFILE DID AND DID NOT RESTORE.
36 shipped files imported FIXTURE_PROFILE from sweep.mjs and sweep.mjs never exported it — 14
tests and 22 probes, dead at link time. The export is now restored and most of them execute.
It does not follow that the D4.27 to D4.30 evidence is restored, and this record exists to stop
that inference being made later by someone reading a green suite.

what_was_repaired.semantics: The two profiles differ on protection toggles and on nothing else. Keeping every other field identical is what makes the pair a control, which is what declinedProtections.test.mjs says it relies on.

well_filled_is_not_the_default.$note: Established by measurement, not assumed, and it is the load-bearing decision in the repair.
well_filled_is_not_the_default.mechanism: sampleFor answers a select with options[0]. include_force_majeure and include_entire_agreement declare their options as ["No","Yes"], so the plain default DECLINES them.
well_filled_is_not_the_default.verification: Generated SERVICE_AGREEMENT, MASTER_SERVICE_AGREEMENT and CONSULTANCY_AGREEMENT with the plain default and read which clause ids were occupied. include_entire_agreement answered "No" and CORE_ENTIRE_AGREEMENT_001 was absent in all three.
well_filled_is_not_the_default.why_it_matters: declinedProtections states the contract in terms — MINIMAL_DECLINED declines every optional protection, WELL_FILLED accepts them. A WELL_FILLED defined as the plain default would have satisfied all 41 imports and silently inverted half of the pairing that test exists to control.

incidental_observation.finding: Under the plain default include_force_majeure answers "No" and CORE_FORCE_MAJEURE_001 is present anyway, in all three families examined.
incidental_observation.status: NOT INVESTIGATED HERE — this repair was scoped to infrastructure and a declined protection appearing is a content question. declinedProtections.test.mjs fails on exactly this and is listed below.

$note: D4.32 opened with one missing export. Diagnosing the last failing test found a second, larger
instance of the same class: the whole scripts/lib/ directory was absent from the repository.
why_this_one_was_recoverable_and_the_fix: The fixture population had no specification anywhere — its richer sample definitions existed
only in a working copy and nothing in the repository records what they were, so reconstruction
could only have been a guess dressed as a repair.
This module is different in kind. probeContract.test.mjs SHIPPED, it is a specification rather
than a usage example, and it fixes all four exports across twelve assertions — including the
exact three-way select that caused error #5 and the gate that caused error #3. Reconstruction
here is verifiable against a recorded contract, not inferred from call sites.
The distinction is worth keeping: a lost dependency is recoverable when its contract shipped,
and not otherwise. Same failure class, different evidentiary position.

what_the_contract_test_still_catches.finding: scripts/reviewpack.mjs chooses an answer with `def.options[0]` — positional choice, recorded as measurement error #4.
what_the_contract_test_still_catches.diagnosis: It carries a COPY of sampleFor from sweep.mjs: 31 of 36 lines identical, comments included.
why_it_is_not_simply_exempted: probeContract exempts freezeClauseBaseline.mjs on the ground that a sampler chooses a specimen
VALUE rather than an answer with a position — AND that sweep.mjs states which profile it
represents. The second half is the condition, and the duplicate in reviewpack states nothing.
Widening the exemption would silence the check while leaving two samplers free to drift apart.
That is the failure this module exists to prevent, so the check is left failing.

duplicated_sampler.finding: scripts/reviewpack.mjs carried its own copy of sampleFor and chose answers by position in the option list — measurement error #4.
duplicated_sampler.why_the_duplicate_existed: Its header said so: sweep.mjs was not in the repository, so reading the sampler from it meant the script could not run from a clean checkout. sweep.mjs is tracked now, so the stated reason had expired.

how_far_they_had_drifted.$method: Extracted the inlined sampler and compared it field by field against sweep.mjs across every document type.
how_far_they_had_drifted.character: sweep.mjs had grown per-field specimens — a real cheque number, a real notice narrative — while the copy still answered most free text with one generic sentence about industrial pumps.

consequence_found.reading: They were built by the OLD sampler, so the pack an advocate reviews was measured on a different population from the one the suite measures. This is the population-provenance problem again, this time between two committed files rather than between a working copy and the repository.
consequence_found.$not_done: reviewpack.json was NOT regenerated. It is now stale with respect to the authoritative sampler, and regenerating it changes a delivered artifact — a visible act that should be taken deliberately, not as a side effect of deduplication.

duplicated_sampler.repair: reviewpack.mjs now imports sampleFor from sweep.mjs. The inlined sampler and its dead constants are gone. Its variable-assembly logic — required-only with a retry that fills what generation asks for — is untouched, because the invariant at stake is one authoritative definition of SAMPLING SEMANTICS, not one way of assembling a fixture.

incidental.finding: probeContract's scan is a regex over source text and does not distinguish code from comments. Describing the banned spelling in a comment re-triggers it.
incidental.status: NOT FIXED — noted. Making the detector comment-aware is a change to a guard, and a guard is not loosened in passing.

three_dimensions_of_provenance.$note: D4.31 exposed one, D4.32 exposed two more. They are not interchangeable: the first asks what produced the measurement, the second what population it measured, the third whether a lost artifact may be rebuilt at all.

repository_provenance.failure: We did not know which tree produced the measurement.

population_provenance.failure: We know which tree produced today's measurement, and we do not know whether today's population is the population that produced the historical one.
population_provenance.enforced_by: this record, and tests/fixtureProfileContract.test.mjs asserting that no continuity is claimed

three_dimensions_of_provenance.property: A historical measurement is not continuous merely because the same test name executes and produces a comparable number. Continuity requires the same measurement population, or a demonstrated equivalence between populations.
three_dimensions_of_provenance.$why_it_bites_here: Every one of the seven still-failing tests would go green under some population. Choosing that population to make them green would be choosing the answer.

specification_provenance.question: What authoritative record tells us what the missing artifact was supposed to MEAN?
specification_provenance.why_it_is_separate: It is what decides whether a lost artifact may be reconstructed at all. A usage pattern tells you how something was consumed; it does not tell you what it was for.
specification_provenance.rule: Reconstruction is admissible where a contract for the artifact exists in the repository, and not otherwise.
worked: semanticMutation.mjs — probeContract.test.mjs shipped and specifies all four exports. ADMISSIBLE, and verified: 12 of 12.
the historical fixture population — no specification anywhere. NOT ADMISSIBLE; reconstruction could only be a guess dressed as a repair.

three_dimensions_of_provenance.governance_principle: Choosing the population that makes the tests green is choosing the answer. A suite that admits it stops falsifying anything: test fails, alter population, test passes, declare the regression resolved.

evidence_classes_for_the_handoff.$note: What the next phase may and may not treat as current.

A_population_independent.rule: Grounded in clause text, knowledge records and schemas rather than in fixture coverage, so the lost population probably does not invalidate them. PROBABLY is not CHECKED — re-derive on the current tree before treating them as current evidence.

examples: how many families exhibit a relationship
B_population_dependent.rule: Must be re-run against the adopted population. A figure of this kind carried forward from D4.27-D4.30 is historical.

C_historical.rule: The D4.27-D4.30 numbers whose original population cannot be reconstructed. They stay historical and are never silently promoted back to current evidence.

d432_closure.handoff: D4.33 is substantive legal and product reasoning. No further measurement-infrastructure phase unless a concrete measurement failure appears in the course of it.
$closing_note: The measurement work ends having done the thing it was built for, twice.
It stopped a product problem being fixed by changing the experiment — the population was never
redefined to the families that happened to generate.
And once the experiment was trustworthy it produced a defect nobody was looking for: an
undeclared constraint scope is a universal one, so an affidavit is required to have lawful
consideration. That finding was unreachable while the tree being measured was unknown.
